bounded_contexts.name: cloud-network-dns
bounded_contexts.description: Code-backed Cloud Network DNS local foundation for DNS zone create API boundaries, public/private DNS zone domain invariants, provider-neutral OCI/self-hosted DNS command shaping, and CoreDNS/Cilium/Envoy cell guardrail metadata. No authoritative DNS serving, recursive resolver runtime, DNSSEC signing service, anycast, health-check routing, REST server, SDK, worker, measured SLO, active-active DR, sharding automation, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001.

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.

audit_chain.non_claim: No live DNS audit-chain writer, query-log exporter, or Merkle seal persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw DNS provider credential, TSIG key, DNSSEC KSK/ZSK private material, kubeconfig, or Cilium/Envoy token is introduced or consumed by this local foundation.

mesh_layering.non_claim: The Rust guardrail validates intended DNS/network posture metadata only; it does not deploy CoreDNS, serve authoritative/recursive DNS, or apply Cilium policy.

data_classification: PUBLIC DNS metadata, INTERNAL_ONLY control-plane metadata, AUDIT evidence

capacity_model.notes: CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001 adds metadata validation and API/adapter command-shape tests only. Runtime authoritative/recursive DNS serving, DNSSEC signing, health-check routing, anycast, SLOs, and capacity telemetry remain explicit non-claims.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No DNS autosharding, auto-rebalance, dynamic sharding execution, tenant migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001.

dr.non_claim: No live DNS runtime store, health-check failover drill, anycast withdrawal, active-active replication, or DR evidence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: DNS is Tier-3 intended future edge/runtime substrate. CS-CLOUD-NETWORK-DNS-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.
foundation_non_claims: no authoritative DNS server, recursive resolver, DNSSEC signer, HSM integration, anycast control plane, health-check routing engine, REST server, SDK crate, worker, Kubernetes controller, Envoy xDS adapter, CoreDNS deployment adapter, Cilium policy apply path, or live data-plane reconciler is implemented

no measured DNS SLO, benchmark, p99 latency, active-active DR, anycast withdrawal, DNS sharding execution, query-log pipeline, provider lockfile, OpenTofu plan/apply, or capacity telemetry evidence exists for Cloud Network DNS runtime
legacy Cloud Network DNS Markdown benchmark/parity/runbook files may remain historical planning/prose but are not used as implementation-ready evidence by this manifest
